<cite ref="Berakhot 61a:26">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>דלא דרי ט׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>טידי</he>) when he is not carrying a load.

<cite ref="Zevachim 32b:8">Zeb. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>מטוּנָךְ</he> I borrow thine own argument; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 4a">R. Hash. 4ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 132a">Ḥull. 132ᵃ</cite> top (Rashi derives fr. <cite ref="M00995"><he>מְטֵי</he></cite>: ‘we have reached thee’).—Pl. <he>טוּנִין</he>.
